carbon-black.$description: Carbon Black — Primary text, logo plate, pill-button fills, hairline borders, icon strokes — the dominant ink that carries every label, heading, and outline

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, product image backdrops, button text on dark fills, inverted text on category overlays

concrete-gray.$description: Concrete Gray — Card borders, thumbnail dividers, secondary dividers between product cells — the structural neutral that frames the grid

mist-gray.$description: Mist Gray — Subtle surface tint for inactive button states and soft fill washes, never a page background

iron-gray.$description: Iron Gray — Deep shadow tone and heavier border treatment for elevated containers and section breaks

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Muted secondary text, body helpers, tertiary borders — the gray that whispers beneath the ink

ink.$description: Ink — Rare near-black accent for solid button fills that need a touch of warmth without drifting to pure carbon

caution-yellow.$description: Caution Yellow — Yellow wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content.

ui-sans-serif.$description: ui-sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

akkstdrg-akkurat-standard.$description: Sole brand typeface. The neo-grotesque Swiss workhorse used for everything from display headlines down to 8px eyebrow labels. Weight stays at 400 — no bold weight exists in the system; emphasis is achieved through size, uppercase, and tracking. The 0.74 line-height on display sizes is anti-conventional and creates a compressed, industrial poster effect. Wide tracking on small sizes (0.04–0.05em) gives labels the spacing of machine-stamped serial numbers.

frg-freitag-regular.$description: Reserved for product model codes (F141 CLARK, F531 ARCHER) — a secondary condensed-mark treatment that makes the SKU read as a stamped part number on a shipping crate
